projects.title: SwiftLogistics
projects.description: A microservices-based logistics and delivery management system built with FastAPI, React (Vite), RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Designed for the SCS2314 Middleware Architecture course to demonstrate real-world middleware integration patterns.

projects.title: esp32 sensovault
projects.description: Real-time temperature, humidity, and light monitoring system using an ESP32, MQTT, and a web dashboard.

projects.title: maze to savor game c
projects.description: Maze Runner Game Simulation with stairs, poles, walls and dice mechanics.

projects.title: Flood Risk App
projects.description: Machine learning flood risk prediction platform for Sri Lanka, built with CatBoost, FastAPI, Next.js, and Supabase. Features interactive risk maps, monitoring dashboards, high-risk alerts, prediction logging, and drift detection.

projects.title: compiler construction
projects.description: A tiny recursive-descent parser/interpreter in C for a minimal language with int declarations and print() statements.

projects.title: movie app
projects.description: A lightweight React + Vite app to browse and favorite movies using a simple movie API. Clean responsive UI with a Browse page, Favorites list, and reusable MovieCard and Navbar components.
